name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain=battle>_<descriptor>; '_buffer' reflects the data type (a byte template/scratch source). No Ghidra address residue. The word 'format' is slightly imprecise (this is a blank "    \0" template primed into the work buffer, NOT a printf format string -- the real "%d" format literal is @ 0x501B6), but the descriptor adequately conveys it is the buffer the damage number is formatted into, and the name is well-established across globals.h / btltab.c / anicombt.c. The minor imprecision is fully clarified in the comment; not worth a churn-heavy rename.
purpose: Read-only pre-fill template (4 ASCII spaces + NUL terminator) used to prime the per-call 8-byte stack work buffer for the floating battle damage-number FX, before each digit is rendered.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_show_damage_number @ 0x1E0DB copies exactly 5 bytes of this template (asm MOVSD + MOVSB; C mirror memcpy(num_string, ..., 5)) into an 8-byte stack scratch buffer 'num_string', then in a 4-iteration loop calls sprintf(num_string, "%d", amount) to render the damage magnitude and enqueues per-digit sprite ids into the floating-damage FX queues. The template's only role is to supply the blank "    \0" initial contents.
datatype: byte[5] (4x 0x20 space + 0x00 NUL). Ghidra currently shows byte[8], but only bytes 0..4 are ever read; bytes 5..7 in that 8-byte view are the first 3 bytes of the adjacent symbol data_fd2_battle_miss_indicator_sprite_ids @ 0x5204A. Datatype dimension not changed in this stage; the C/KB byte[5] already matches the real used extent.
element_semantics: Each byte is one ASCII character of the blank template: index 0..3 = space (0x20), index 4 = NUL terminator (0x00).
notes: Plate was null in Ghidra; created a concise PLATE_COMMENT (via run_script_inline) reflecting the src conclusion (template, NOT-printf clarification, 5-byte MOVSD+MOVSB copy, byte[8] vs used-5 discrepancy, adjacency to miss_indicator @ 0x5204A, read-only). src btltab.c comment block (lines 405-422) already accurate/conclusion-style -> kept, no Edit made. Datatype mismatch (Ghidra byte[8] vs C/used byte[5]) is documented in both comment and plate; deferred (not a refine-stage change). Unrelated working-tree shard 0005239b.json (from another refiner) left untouched; only staged src/table/btltab.c (unchanged) + this shard.
